sentences.en: Her death was a great distress to all the family.
sentences.zh: 她的去世给全家带来了巨大的悲痛。

sentences.en: We have overcome the first obstacle with sorrow and distress.
sentences.zh: 我们怀着悲伤和困苦克服了第一个障碍。

sentences.en: Our hearts go out to all in distress this night.
sentences.zh: 今夜我们的心与所有身处困境的人同在。

senses.zh: 忧虑，悲伤，不幸，苦恼，贫困，忧郁，恶化，扣押财物
